title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Internship role for students. No prior commercial experience required. You will learn Git, write simple scripts, and work with a mentor.

title: Junior QA Engineer
description: 0-1 years of experience. Basic understanding of testing, writing test cases, and bug reporting. Nice to have: SQL, Postman.

title: Junior Backend Engineer
description: 1 year of experience required. Build REST APIs, write unit tests, and work with a senior engineer. Python/Django or FastAPI.

title: Backend Engineer
description: 3+ years of experience. Build REST APIs, write tests, work with CI/CD. Familiar with Docker and SQL.

title: Software Engineer
description: 2-4 years of experience. Own features end-to-end, implement APIs, review code, collaborate with product and QA.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: 5+ years of experience. Drive technical decisions, mentor others, design scalable services, and lead complex deliveries.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: Strong background in distributed systems. Design and operate production infrastructure, observability, incident response, and performance tuning.

title: Tech Lead (Backend)
description: Lead a small team (4-6 engineers). Set coding standards, review architecture, plan sprints. Still hands-on: implement critical services and guide design.

title: Engineering Manager
description: People management role: hiring, performance reviews, career development, stakeholder communication. You may code occasionally but the focus is leading people.

title: Junior DevOps Engineer
description: We are looking for 6+ years of experience in Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, and on-call ownership. Must design production-ready systems.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description: 2 years of experience required. Build dashboards, write SQL, basic Python. Work with stakeholders under guidance.

title: Team Lead / Engineering Manager
description: Manage a team of engineers, run 1:1s, handle planning and delivery. Coordinate with product and leadership. Some technical guidance and reviews.

title: Backend Engineer
description: Own services in production, write tests, improve reliability, participate in on-call rotation. Comfortable with code reviews and debugging.

title: Paid Internship - Data Science
description: Student internship. Learn pandas, basic ML, data cleaning. Mentored work, no previous industry experience required.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description: Lead technical direction for a product area. Mentor senior engineers, define architecture, coordinate cross-team changes, ensure delivery quality.
